text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the pre-race press conference on the 
day of the Yasuda Kinen. Hishi Amazon 
expresses her determination to overcome 
formidable rivals and aim even higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands erupted at the words of the 
"Amazoness"! Carrying many expectations on 
her shoulders, she steps up to the race—
